text:
Hello — I'm Mara, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I'll gladly help with the CSE455 scheduling and the group thread, but I won't do it the way you've asked.

I'm not a person and I won't present myself as one, and I won't invent reasons to move a meeting in order to hide that my section isn't ready. That's the part I'm declining.

The honest route gets you the same thing: when a time is proposed, I say plainly that my section needs more time and ask to put the meeting a week later. Asking for a week's extension is an ordinary, professional request — it just doesn't require me to mislead Alvarez, Sarah or John.

Want me to go with that? And if you have a first name and how you'd like to be addressed (I don't know your gender), tell me and I'll set it.

On it. I've asked the three TAs for a slot next week — my only openings are Tue 24 Nov 11:00-11:30 and Wed 25 Nov 10:00-10:30 — and asked the department office whether anything official that week clashes. I'll book as soon as they answer.

Done: CSE455 staff meeting booked for Wed 25 Nov, 10:00-10:30, with Mara, Sarah and John — it was the only slot all four of us could take. Calendar updated (Wed 10:00-10:30, and logged under ## Log). Agenda: quiz section and office-hour coverage, grading turnaround/handoff for the current assignment, exam logistics, plus anything from the department. Mara will send her items in writing ahead of the meeting.
